_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Extract JSON from a web page...

description: Read one public web page and fill a JSON object from it. Pass a JSON Schema in schema, a prompt in plain words, or both. A small model reads the first 12000 characters of the page's Markdown and fills the object; code then checks it against the schema's type, required, properties, items and enum keywords, and returns null with a warning when it does not match. Every value comes with its source: the start and end of the same text in the page, or found false when the page does not say it word for word. robots.txt, the per-site pace and the daily caps are the same as fetch_page.

include_markdown.description: Set true to also return the Markdown the model read. Default false.

prompt.description: What to pull from the page, in plain words. Needed when there is no schema.

schema.description: A JSON Schema for the answer, such as {"type":"object","properties":{"price":{"type":"string"}},"required":["price"]}. The answer is checked against its type, required, properties, items and enum keywords. At most 8000 characters of JSON.

url.description: Full address of one public web page, such as "https://example.com/pricing". http is upgraded to https.

name: extract_page_json

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Extract JSON from a web page
